title: UAAP: Tope Lagat, Mo Tañedo finally get to savor a UE victory

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—When Tope Lagat and Mo Tañedo were in the University of the East’s lineup last year, they never knew what a victory tasted like. They were part of the Red Warriors’ winless UAAP Season 88 campaign and, by extension, became part of UE’s 30-game losing streak that began all the way back in 2024. The duo, however, finally got to experience a different feeling on Saturday as they helped lead the squad to a breakthrough 53-47 win over Adamson in Season 89 at Smart Araneta Coliseum.
